name: London School of Economics and Political Science

programs.name: Economics BSc
programs.ib_offer: 39 points overall, 766 in Higher Level subjects, with 7 in Mathematics
programs.ap_offer: A*AA / AAA equivalent: five APs at grade 5 taken over a maximum of three years and a minimum High School Diploma GPA of 3.7; or a minimum GPA of 3.7 with ACT 32+ or SAT 1450+ (with AP Calculus BC at grade 5 for programmes with a Mathematics requirement). Mathematics A*/A is equivalent to Calculus BC grade 5. The US High School Diploma alone is not sufficient; AP Seminar, Capstone and Research do not count; only one of Calculus AB or BC may count.
programs.required_subjects: Mathematics (A* at A-level; 7 at IB HL). Economics not required
programs.toefl_note: TOEFL iBT 100 overall with at least 27 Writing, 25 Reading, 24 Listening, 24 Speaking (old 0-120 scale); 5.5 overall with at least 5 in each of Writing, Reading, Listening and Speaking on the updated scale (tests from January 2026). One sitting only; valid for 2 years before 1 September of entry.
programs.english_note: LSE undergraduate English language requirement: IELTS Academic 7.0 overall and 7.0 in each component (one sitting). Also accepted: PTE Academic (in person) 70 overall with 70 in all components; Cambridge C1 Advanced / C2 Proficiency 185 overall and in each component. Duolingo English Test is not listed. Proof is only requested if LSE makes an offer, due before LSE's July deadline.
programs.notes: LSE has no Engineering degree and no Computer Science degree; Economics is its flagship course. An A* in Further Mathematics plus an A in Mathematics is an acceptable alternative to A* in Mathematics. Entry values and the overseas fee are for 2027/28 entry (start 27 September 2027). AP route: https://www.lse.ac.uk/study-at-lse/international-students/country-pages/united-states-of-america . English: https://www.lse.ac.uk/study-at-lse/Undergraduate/Prospective-Students/How-to-Apply/English-language-requirements . Deadline: UCAS 13 Jan 2027, 18:00 UK time (page states 13 January 2027). Contextual offers (A*AB / IB 38) exist for eligible applicants.
